draft_key_information_units.information: Gigasun's installed solar capacity increased to 395.8 MW from 340.1 MW, representing a 16% year-over-year growth and expanding its portfolio to 216 electricity-generating installations.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: On 31 December 2025, Gigasun had a portfolio of 216 (200) electricity-generating solar energy installations with a total capacity of 395.8 (340.1) MW.

draft_key_information_units.information: The company reported revenue of SEK 239.7 million (up 9.8% YoY) and operating profit of SEK 73.5 million (up 21.1% YoY), with adjusted core profitability reaching SEK 0.1 million after excluding a SEK 3.8 million currency effect and SEK 3.5 million one-off cost.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenues amounted to SEK 239.7 (218.3) million... Operating profit amounted to SEK 73.5 (60.7) million... Profit after tax amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million and were impacted by a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3.8 (1.8) million as well as a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million. Adjusted... profit amounted to SEK 0.1 (-34.7) million.

draft_key_information_units.information: Gigasun achieved record performance in Q3 2025, with production increasing by 36% and profit rising by 275% compared to the same quarter in 2024, significantly boosting full-year results.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: The most notable development during the year was our record quarter in Q3. Production increased by 36 percent and profit rose by as much as 275 percent compared with the same period the previous year.

draft_key_information_units.information: The company secured new financing of SEK 372 million through its Chinese subsidiary, extended loan amortization to 10 years at improved rates, and postponed the SOLT4 bond repayment to November 8, 2026, enhancing liquidity and reducing financing costs.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: The company has entered into two agreements with the Chinese company Agricultural Bank Financial Leasing Co., Ltd to refinance approximately SEK 1,242 millions... The interest rate on the new financing is 3.60% and the amortization period has been extended from 7 to 10 years... The remaining bond, SOLT4, has been extended to November 8, 2026.

draft_key_information_units.information: Gigasun expanded into new regions such as Chongqing where declining construction costs now make solar viable, while navigating regulatory tariff adjustments in Jiangsu and Anhui provinces that reduced realized kWh prices by ~8% in H2 2025, impacting revenue by an estimated 3-4%.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Our geographical expansion also continues... expanded into Chongqing... electricity tariffs in the Jiangsu and Anhui provinces were adjusted... reduced the realized price per kWh by approximately 8 percent in the second half of the year... impact on our existing project portfolio is manageable and amounts to approximately a 3–4 percent reduction in revenue.

draft_key_information_units.information: Total electricity production reached 327.8 million kWh in 2025 (up 30% YoY), reducing CO2 emissions by approximately 161,000 tonnes (vs 124,000 tonnes in 2024), contributing to China's climate transition.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: During the year, 327.8 (252.6) million kWh were generated, reducing CO2-related emissions by approximately 161,000 (124,000) tonnes.

draft_key_information_units.information: The company signed 17 contracts for 41.7 MW of new capacity in 2025 (down from 15 contracts for 56.6 MW in 2024), with signed orders standing at 16.4 MW at year-end (compared to 38.8 MW in 2024), indicating a strategic shift in order intake patterns.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: The Company signed 17 (15) contracts representing total installed capacity of 41.7 (56.6) MW. At the end of the year, the Company had 16.4 (38.8) MW in signed orders.

evaluation.selection_rationale: These units capture material themes central to Gigasun's 2025 performance: headline capacity expansion (D1), financial results including adjustments for non-recurring items (D2), exceptional quarterly performance driving annual profit growth (D3), strategic refinancing and liquidity improvements (D4), geographic expansion and regulatory impacts on pricing (D5), operational output and environmental impact (D6), and contract pipeline dynamics (D7). Each unit represents an independently omittable theme covering key performance indicators, major changes, drivers, segment developments, and liquidity positioning as prioritized. The selection balances comprehensiveness with conciseness, avoiding routine boilerplate while ensuring all factual details are source-supported.
